functions.name: pit_flow
functions.sourceReview: Whole dig.c:pit_flow (1844-1882): guard on trap, filltyp != ROOM and is_pit; copy the trap before liquid_flow deletes it/clears links; update terrain and flags; choose the message from u_at; recurse through copied conjoined bits in N_DIRS order. The liquid_flow return is discarded in C. Existing is_pit/u_at/t_at and xdir/ydir provide the source contracts.

C dig.c:pit_flow recursively calls pit_flow for each copied conjoined direction bit at 1878.
